deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Apps".
Click on "Manage apps" and search for the app that provides the returns reason capture form functionality.
Install and configure the app according to its instructions, which may include setting up API connections or customizing form fields.
Once the app is set up, navigate to "Settings" > "Policies" and select the return policy associated with your store.
In the return policy settings, click on the "Edit" button next to "Return reason".
Select the option to use a custom return reason capture form and enter the app's API key or token in the provided field.
Save the changes to enable the returns reason capture form in your Shopify returns flow.
To test the integration, initiate a return from your store's customer account page. The returns reason capture form should appear on the return submission page.
If you encounter any issues during setup or testing, refer to the app's documentation and support resources for assistance.
